ri.ORDER_NUMBER as MATCHED_ORDER_NUMBER, ri.CUSTOMER_NAME as MATCHED_CUSTOMER_NAME, ri.RETURN_TYPE_CODE as MATCHED_RETURN_TYPE_CODE, ri.CS_RECEIVED_DATE as MATCHED_CS_RECEIVED_DATE

where.if: AND ( UPPER(ldr.CUSTOMER_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(ldr.PRODUCT_CODE) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(ldr.TRACKING_NUMBER) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(ldr.COURIER_COMPANY) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(ldr.REMARKS) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') )

mapper.insert:
SELECT TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN ( DIRECT_RETURN_ID, RECEIVED_DATE, SITE_NAME, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PHONE, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_COLOR, PRODUCT_SIZE, QUANTITY, TRACKING_NUMBER, COURIER_COMPANY, REMARKS, PROCESSING_STATUS, MATCHED_RETURN_ID, MAPPING_STATUS, MAPPING_DATE, MAPPING_BY, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{receivedDate}, #{siteName}, #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, #{productCode}, #{productColor}, #{productSize}, #{quantity}, #{trackingNumber}, #{courierCompany}, #{remarks}, #{processingStatus}, #{matchedReturnId}, #{mappingStatus}, #{mappingDate}, #{mappingBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN SET RECEIVED_DATE = #{receivedDate}, SITE_NAME = #{siteName}, CUSTOMER_NAME = #{customerName}, CUSTOMER_PHONE = #{customerPhone}, PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode}, PRODUCT_COLOR = #{productColor}, PRODUCT_SIZE = #{productSize}, QUANTITY = #{quantity}, TRACKING_NUMBER = #{trackingNumber}, COURIER_COMPANY = #{courierCompany}, REMARKS = #{remarks}, PROCESSING_STATUS = #{processingStatus}, MATCHED_RETURN_ID = #{matchedReturnId}, MAPPING_STATUS = #{mappingStatus}, MAPPING_DATE = #{mappingDate}, MAPPING_BY = #{mappingBy}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE DIRECT_RETURN_ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT RETURN_ID, ORDER_NUMBER, CUSTOMER_NAME, RETURN_TYPE_CODE, CS_RECEIVED_DATE, TRACKING_NUMBER, SITE_NAME FROM TB_RETURN_ITEM WHERE TRACKING_NUMBER = #{trackingNumber} ORDER BY CS_RECEIVED_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN SET MATCHED_RETURN_ID = #{matchedReturnId}, MAPPING_STATUS = #{mappingStatus}, MAPPING_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP, MAPPING_BY = #{mappingBy}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE DIRECT_RETURN_ID = #{id}

UPDATE TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN SET MATCHED_RETURN_ID = NULL, MAPPING_STATUS = 'PENDING', MAPPING_DATE = NULL, MAPPING_BY = NULL, UPDATED_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE DIRECT_RETURN_ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN MAPPING_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as PENDING_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN MAPPING_STATUS = 'MATCHED' THEN 1 END) as MATCHED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN MAPPING_STATUS = 'UNMATCHED' THEN 1 END) as UNMATCHED_COUNT FROM TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN

SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN PROCESSING_STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 END) as RECEIVED_COUNT, COUNT(CASE WHEN PROCESSING_STATUS = 'PROCESSED' THEN 1 END) as PROCESSED_COUNT FROM TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN
SELECT COUNT(*) as TODAY_COUNT FROM TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN WHERE RECEIVED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT ,
FROM TB_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_RETURN ldr LEFT JOIN TB_RETURN_ITEM ri ON ldr.MATCHED_RETURN_ID = ri.RETURN_ID
ORDER BY ldr.DIRECT_RETURN_ID DESC
